trigger.Name: Events
trigger.script:
local day = tonumber(strsub(os.date(), 4, 5)) local month = tonumber(strsub(os.date(), 1, 2)) local year = tonumber(strsub(os.date(), 7, 8))
if IsUserInfoLineExists("Season") and ReadValueUserInfo("UserTimeYear") == "1" then SEASON = ReadValueUserInfo("Season") if SEASON == "WINTER" then TActivate("WinterWeather") end if SEASON == "SPRING" then TActivate("SpringWeather") end if SEASON == "SUMMER" then TActivate("SummerWeather") end if SEASON == "AUTUMN" then TActivate("SummerWeather") end else if month == 12 or month == 1 or month == 2 then SEASON = "WINTER" TActivate("WinterWeather") end
if month == 3 or month == 4 or month == 5 then SEASON = "SPRING" TActivate("SpringWeather") end
if month == 6 or month == 7 or month == 8 then SEASON = "SUMMER" TActivate("SummerWeather") end
if month == 9 or month == 10 or month == 11 then SEASON = "AUTUMN" TActivate("SummerWeather") end
EditUserInfo("Season", "Season: "..SEASON) end
if month == 12 and day >= 25 or month == 1 and day >= 1 and 10 >= day then EVENT = "NEW_YEAR" end if month == 12 and day == 8 and year == 25 then EVENT = "BIRTHDAY_EXMACHINA" end if month == 4 and day == 1 then EVENT = "1_APRIL" end if month == 4 and day >= 2 and not(10 > day) then EVENT = "1_APRIL_MULTIPLAYER" end
if EVENT == "BIRTHDAY_EXMACHINA" and year == 25 then EditUserInfo("QuestItemDiskExMachina", "QuestItemDiskExMachina: 1") end
if EVENT == "1_APRIL" and year == 26 then EditUserInfo("QuestItem1Year", "QuestItem1Year: 1") end
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: MusicStart
trigger.script: if EVENT == "NEW_YEAR" then PlayCustomMusic("christmas_music") SetVar("Track", 180) elseif EVENT == "BIRTHDAY_EXMACHINA" then PlayCustomMusic("mainmenu") SetVar("Track", 174) elseif EVENT == "1_APRIL" then SetVar("Track", 0) else PlayCustomMusic("mainmenu_remaster") SetVar("Track", 175) end TActivate("MusicTimer") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: Music
trigger.script:
local list if EVENT == "1_APRIL" then list = {"music04_gachi", "music06_gachi", "music07_gachi", "music08_gachi", "music09_gachi", "music12_gachi"} else list = {"music01", "music02", "music03", "music04", "music05", "music06", "music07", "music08", "music09", "music10", "music11", "music12"} end
local music = list[random(getn(list))] if music == GetVar("LastTrack").AsString then return end
SetVar("LastTrack", music)
if music == "music01" then SetVar("Track", 257) end if music == "music02" then SetVar("Track", 358) end if music == "music03" then SetVar("Track", 232) end if music == "music04" or music == "music04_gachi" then SetVar("Track", 244) end if music == "music05" then SetVar("Track", 228) end if music == "music06" or music == "music06_gachi" then SetVar("Track", 218) end if music == "music07" or music == "music07_gachi" then SetVar("Track", 329) end if music == "music08" or music == "music08_gachi" then SetVar("Track", 177) end if music == "music09" or music == "music09_gachi" then SetVar("Track", 203) end if music == "music10" then SetVar("Track", 236) end if music == "music11" then SetVar("Track", 230) end if music == "music12" or music == "music12_gachi" then SetVar("Track", 262) end
PlayCustomMusic(music)
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: MusicTimer
trigger.script:
local time = GetVar("Track").AsInt
if GetVar("Track").AsInt > 0 then time = time - 1 SetVar("Track", time) else TActivate("Music") end

trigger.Name: SummerWeather
trigger.script:
SetWeather(0) RuleConsole("testShadowRenderToGrass yes")
for i = 189, 380 do local tree = getObj("Object"..i) if tree then tree:SetSkin(0) end end
for d = 1, 5 do local dub = getObj("dub_"..d) if dub then dub:Remove() end end
TActivate("CreateDubs") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: WinterWeather
trigger.script:
SetWeather(random(1,3)) RuleConsole("testShadowRenderToGrass no")
for i = 189, 380 do local tree = getObj("Object"..i) if tree then tree:SetSkin(1) end end
for d = 1, 5 do local dub = getObj("dub_"..d) if dub then dub:Remove() end end
TActivate("CreateDubs") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: SpringWeather
trigger.script:
SetWeather(random(4,5)) RuleConsole("testShadowRenderToGrass yes")
for i = 189, 380 do local tree = getObj("Object"..i) if tree then local prot = tree:GetProperty("Prototype").AsString if strsub(prot, 1, 14) == "Breakable_Elka" or strsub(prot, 1, 15) == "Breakable_Sosna" then tree:SetSkin(0) else tree:SetSkin(2) end end end
for d = 1, 5 do local dub = getObj("dub_"..d) if dub then dub:Remove() end end
TActivate("CreateDubs") trigger:Deactivate()
